initial_state: cash before first risky-asset entry; risky drift weights are all zero
initial_turnover: full-L1 distance from zero risky holdings to first target policy; equals one for a fully invested long-only policy
fee_units: proportion of full-L1 turnover; a complete switch between two assets has turnover two
terminal_treatment: mark to market after the last holding interval; no liquidation trade and no terminal fee
legacy_equivalence: verified by automated test on valid long-only fully invested policies
